Key Points
• Chromium cannot currently be considered an essential element.
• No deﬁnitive symptoms of chromium deﬁciency have been established.
• Chromium supplementation has no effects on body mass or composition.
• Chromium supplementation has no clinically signiﬁcant effects on the symptoms of insulin resistance or type 2 diabetes.
• Chromium supplementation appears safe at doses of 1 mg/day or less.
Glossary
Adequate Intake (AI) The recommended daily intake of a nutrient estimated to meet or exceed the amount needed to maintain
adequate nutrition for most people in a particular life stage and gender group. An AI is established when not enough
information is available from scientiﬁc research to determine a Recommended Dietary Allowance.
Estimated Average Requirement (EAR) A nutrient intake value estimated to meet the requirement of half the healthy
individuals in a group.
Recommended Daily Allowance (RDA) Average daily level of intake sufﬁcient to meet the nutrient requirements
